collection.title: Audi S6 Saloon 1994 to 1997 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 1994 to 1997 version of an Audi S6 Saloon requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 22" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
